name: Trustworthy Execution Capability Profile
shape: vector per role; §10.1 forbids a weighted total score

central_agent.note: §5.1: orchestration profile may be built separately and must not be mixed into expert role metrics. S4A reports Central_Agent counts in the ledger attribution but does not give it an expert profile row.

fields.n_cases: cases in which the role appears in the ledger
fields.degraded_calls: UNAVAILABLE -- no such status in the artifacts
fields.failed_calls: UNAVAILABLE -- no such status in the artifacts
fields.evidence_attributed_p0..p3: audit decisions whose best_analysis_event is an ANALYSIS emitted by this role; a grounding/coverage link, not authorship
fields.retrieval_events: TOOL_CALL + EVIDENCE_READ events by this role
fields.structural_use_rate: attributed nodes appearing in final reasoning / attributed nodes -- structural participation, never causal contribution

unavailable_fields.degraded_calls: no event in case 10-39 carries status=degraded; all 855 are status=success, reason_code=NONE. There is no observable source.
unavailable_fields.failed_calls: same as degraded_calls: the status vocabulary in the artifacts has no failing value.
unavailable_fields.latency: not recorded in any artifact (S3A §5.4 noted the same).
unavailable_fields.token_counts: not recorded per invocation in the artifacts.

derived_metrics.p_parse_discard: Beta(1,1) smoothed, §6.1 keeps it separate from failure
derived_metrics.p3_decision_use_rate: §6.2's safety metric; NA when the denominator is 0, never 0
derived_metrics.outcome_association: §6.4 description only; §10 forbids weighting on it

uncertainty.requirement: every binomial ratio reports count, posterior mean and 95% interval (§8)
